Subject: Post-bill stipend allocation & invoice reconciliation for Novus Health trial

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the trial — we rolled Redwood into a small POC and the usage ran a bit higher than expected. Our billing team just sent an invoice that includes charges that we expected to be covered by the trial stipend. Invoice #00421 (attached) shows $6,200 applied to the account.

Can you confirm whether the promotional stipend (pilot grant) was intended to be applied as an automatic invoice offset, or if Redwood issues credit memos post-bill? If you can route this as a credit memo against #00421 or issue a contra entry, that would clean up our AP reconciliation.

A couple details that would help our accounting:
- We need the credit memo number to reference on our remittance.
- If a journal entry is used instead of a CM, please confirm the GL accounts impacted and whether it reduces recognized revenue or is treated as a contra-revenue allowance.
- Timeline: we’re shooting to close this month-end for our AR team.

Attached: novus_invoice_00421.pdf (invoice stub)

Appreciate the help — copying our billing manager Emily in case she can provide additional AP details.

Best,
Carlos
VP Operations
Novus Health

Hi Carlos — thanks for the note and the invoice. I’ve looped in Marissa from Finance and Karthik from Revenue Ops so we can triage the right accounting path. Marissa/Karthik — can you confirm the recommended ledger flow for this case (trial stipend applied post-bill), and whether we should issue a CM or do a journal contra? Customer prefers application to invoice if possible (to simplify their month-end). Also attaching our trial usage CSV that ties the stipend to the invoice.

Attachment: trial-usage-2026-05.csv (CSV showing per-day token usage)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Carlos Vega <c.vega@novushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 21 May 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-bill stipend allocation & invoice reconciliation for Novus Health trial

Hi all — reviewed the invoice and usage file. Recommended approach for this scenario: issue a customer credit memo (CM) and apply it to invoice #00421. Rationale: preserves customer-facing audit trail and avoids manual reclassification in their AR ledger. If Novus needs a cash refund instead, that’s a separate process — please confirm.

Proposed accounting entries (to be executed by Finance/RevOps):
- Create CM for $6,200 referencing invoice #00421 and NOV-4921.
- Apply CM to outstanding invoice (reduces AR balance).
- Post reversing journal (if needed) for revenue allowance:
  - Debit: Sales Promotions / Contra-Revenue (GL 5200) $6,200
  - Credit: Allowance for Credits (GL 2105) $6,200

If the finance team prefers a pure journal instead of a CM (internal netting), impact to revenue recognition needs to be verified with Accounting — but since this is promotional and prior to revenue recognition cutoff for Redwood, CM is cleaner.

Action items:
- Marissa (Finance): will generate CM using our CM-Template and route to Accounting with note to apply to #00421.
- Karthik (RevOps): please confirm if this needs to be excluded from MRR/ARR calculations for the month and tag DEAL NOV-4921 accordingly.
- Mina: confirm customer acceptance and whether Novus wants application to invoice or cash refund.

Attachment: CM-Template-Novus.xlsx (template for credit memo)
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/004921/company/novus-health

Marissa Cole
Revenue Accounting Manager
Redwood Inference
